blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Plasma accounts for effectively 100% of circulating yzUSD; Monad contributes 23.7481632850 units, about 0.0000403%. At plasma@35449083 (2026-10-19T06:14:23+00:00; hash 0xd69ea5d44c866b167b5821842f992d56b29ea210add10fdb9d12999b97f48667; observed 2026-10-19T06:19:28.531004+00:00) via https://rpc.plasma.to, canonical proxy 0x6695c0f8706c5ace3bdf8995073179cca47926dc still resolves to verified YuzuUSDV3 0x8e02392855a51d9d5d18d71a7cfc731f56c68ea5. The V3 facet is 0x978b32904b361f22d7338692feb6b9cd8ad1887e. Current isRedeemRestricted()=true and paused()=false. Verified inherited YuzuProtoV2.canRedeem/canCreateRedeemOrder deny owners lacking REDEEMER_ROLE; V3 instant exits and facet-created redeem orders enforce the corresponding owner limits. This is an active holder exit allowlist: syzUSD vault 0xc8a8df9b210243c55d31c73090f06787ad0a1bf6 holds 58,545,215.944134340535783031 yzUSD units but has no REDEEMER_ROLE and canRedeem(vault)=false. RESTRICTION_MANAGER_ROLE and ADMIN_ROLE are both assigned to 12-hour TimelockController 0x5f3d29ef17700f8658c566dac7fbd76e0d86b78c; the current 3-of-5 Safe 0xe61ad2de346db42879b6ee3c7cf0c6a2cdc0530d has proposer/executor/canceller roles there, so role revocation can target an existing holder. Under the reviewed exit-gate rule this qualifies as Yes. Ordinary ERC-20 transfers are not blacklisted: V3's _update tracks same-block received shares for redemption eligibility, while V2 burn consumes only the caller's own tokens. Independently, ProxyAdmin 0x6ccfd86ee6f0ceaa4946612a9faae257c064d2aa remains owned by 48-hour timelock 0x2130457539612ae9838e0314cda1a8abbdb7cfbc, so token implementation mutability would be Possible even without the active exit gate. Hypernative interaction blocking and Fordefi Sentinel wallet withdrawals do not prove transfer interception and are not the verdict basis. Upstream reserve controls are separate and do not supersede a direct verdict. Monad's live upgrade controls are below the materiality threshold.

oracleRisk.summary: At Plasma block 33896709, yzUSD uses the YuzuUSDV3 implementation. Mint and redemption conversions apply a stored NAV capped at par. Its configured facet gates setNav and setNavUpdateInProgress with NAV_MANAGER_ROLE; NAV changes normally have a one-day cooldown and 10% step cap, with markdown-step exemptions. The live NAV was 1e18 and navLastUpdate was zero. This is a privileged top-level internal valuation path, not an oracleless product; no external feed or borrower-specific liquidation branch is identified in this path. The from-deployment grant census found no active NAV_MANAGER_ROLE recipients at this block. On-chain getRoleAdmin assigns NAV_MANAGER_ROLE to ADMIN_ROLE, held by the 12-hour manager timelock 0x5f3d29ef17700f8658c566dac7fbd76e0d86b78c, which can grant the pricing role.

branchApplicability.rationale: The verified V3 code applies a stored NAV to pooled mint and redemption conversions. It delegates the role-gated NAV setter to a configured facet; this is a top-level token valuation authority rather than borrower-specific collateral-price liquidation branches. The current review does not rely on the prior unsupported 110% redemption-ratio assertion.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: yzUSD's only material deployment is native issuance on Plasma. DefiLlama still reports ~24 yzUSD on a legacy Monad LayerZero OFT (0x9dcB0D17eDDE04D27F387c89fECb78654C373858), but peers(eid) returns zero for all probed endpoint ids on the Monad OFT (re-verified 2026-07-20 at block 88919965) and Yuzu announced it replaced LayerZero with Chainlink CCIP as its exclusive cross-chain infrastructure. The dormant Monad residue is inventoried as a reviewed subthreshold retired route and excluded from material tiering.
